dictionary.title: Sentinel
dictionary.native_missing: The Nuxiva native engine is not installed on this server yet: without it Sentinel cannot encrypt the diary.
dictionary.disabled: Sentinel is turned off in the features.
dictionary.integrity_bad: Invalid signature: the diary may have been altered
dictionary.torn: An interrupted write was set aside
dictionary.retention_hint: Days each kind of event stays in the diary. When a day expires its key is destroyed and the data becomes unreadable.
dictionary.delete_confirm: Permanently delete every event of this day?
dictionary.audit_hint: Every read of the diary is recorded in the diary itself.
dictionary.native_restarting: The new native engine is installed: restarting the supervisor to load it.
dictionary.native_disabled: The native engine is turned off in the system settings (NUXIVA_NATIVE=0), so Sentinel stays off.
dictionary.native_auto_open: Sentinel opens by itself as soon as the engine is ready, no restart needed.
dictionary.native_requested: Build started: follow the progress in System update
dictionary.native_rebuild_failed: Could not start the build: try again from System update.
dictionary.nvr_ask_hint: Search what the cameras heard or saw. Search uses an encrypted index: words cannot be read on the disk.
dictionary.nvr_ask_placeholder: E.g. who talked about the parcel yesterday?
dictionary.nvr_notice_hint: Audio is recorded only while the notice is on: Nuxiva shows it on screens and says it aloud when something changes and at regular intervals.
dictionary.nvr_notice_pending: waiting for quiet hours to end
dictionary.nvr_audio_hint: Audio stays off until you turn it on. Bathrooms, bedrooms and changing rooms are always excluded.
dictionary.nvr_person_hint: Download or delete everything a person said in the recordings: transcripts, search index and, if you want, the videos where they speak.
dictionary.nvr_voice_consent_no: They did not agree to voice recognition: their name is not stored in transcripts.
dictionary.nvr_erase_clips: Also delete the videos where they speak
dictionary.nvr_erase_confirm: Delete all of {name}'s sentences from transcripts and the index?
dictionary.nvr_erase_confirm_clips: Delete {name}'s sentences and the videos where they speak? This cannot be undone.
